comment: The workforce example refers to a “licensed health worker,” which may exclude community health workers, traditional practitioners, volunteers, trainees, and other cadres without formal professional licensing.

anchor.note: p.95 l.Lines 273-283 read as the printed page; section 4.3.1 agrees

public.text: The workforce example refers to a “licensed health worker,” which may exclude community health workers, traditional practitioners, volunteers, trainees, and other cadres without formal professional licensing.
public.suggestedRevision: Replace with “recognised health worker” and model professional registration, certification, employment authorisation, community accreditation, or other nationally applicable status separately.
